verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia is positioned as an open-source desktop API client for local design/testing (kong-docs-6), implying offline local workspaces, but community evidence explicitly reports that Insomnia 'now requires an account,' pushing users to seek alternatives — directly contradicting fully offline, account-free use (kong-comm-3, kong-comm-4). No docs evidence confirms an offline-only mode without cloud login. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an offline/local-only mode, first-party confirmation that no cloud account is required, and independent corroboration resolving the community complaint.
